paragraphs.p1: I'm a <bold>mid-level Full Stack Developer</bold> with <bold>3+ years of experience</bold> building scalable web applications, business automations and multi-tenant systems.
paragraphs.p2: I work end to end — from gathering requirements to architecture, development and delivery — with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js/NestJS, C# .NET and PostgreSQL.
paragraphs.p3: I have been the technical lead on the full development of a <bold>multi-currency financial platform (BRL/USD)</bold> and of a cultural mapping platform for the <bold>Government of Ceará</bold>, <italic>Cartografia da Cultura & Rede Mobilize</italic>.
paragraphs.p4: I hold a degree in <bold>Systems Analysis and Development</bold> from UNIASSELVI and enjoy working with technical autonomy in small teams, taking part in architecture decisions and external integrations.

paragraphs.p1: Hello! I'm Jeferson Fernandes, a full stack developer passionate about technology. My journey began a few years ago with curiosity about programming, and since then I have been evolving to build modern and functional web applications.
paragraphs.p2: I am currently in the 5th semester of Systems Analysis and Development and have worked on projects using technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, .NET, Entity Framework, and relational databases.
paragraphs.p3: My focus is to combine performance, usability, and development best practices to deliver solutions that truly make a difference for companies and users.
paragraphs.p4: Outside the coding world, I enjoy learning new things, sharing knowledge, and participating in initiatives that strengthen the tech community.

description: Built a system for managing and automatically generating custom contracts in 3 months, using React, Next.js and .NET.
Improved and optimized existing features, making the contract generation workflow more efficient.
End-to-end work on several projects at once, most notably as technical lead of a multi-currency financial platform (BRL/USD).
Led the full development of the platform — architecture, backend, frontend and admin panel — from requirements to production.
Structured the backend with Clean Architecture, separating domain, application and infrastructure layers for easier maintenance and testing.
Implemented JWT authentication and integrations with real-time currency conversion APIs, keeping BRL and USD balances consistent.
Built admin dashboards that automate the withdrawal flow, reducing the operations team's manual work when reviewing transactions.
For other clients, built automations with WhatsApp, webhooks and chatbots, and worked directly with them to define business rules and technical solutions.
Responsible for the architecture and development of a multi-tenant operations management system, from scratch to deploy.
Built a shift and attendance management system with a multi-tenant architecture, ensuring data isolation and scalability across clients sharing the same database.
Implemented WhatsApp and phone call automations to confirm shifts, reducing manual work for the clients' HR teams.
Designed a full audit trail of operations, making data more reliable in disputes or operational errors.
Modeled a complex relational database in PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, with advanced relationships and fine-grained per-tenant permissions.
Built integrations and automations with N8N, removing manual steps from recurring administrative processes.

Helped bring more than 100 cultural organizations online, widening public access to cultural information in the state.
Integrated forms and automated data collection flows, making it easier for the government team to keep the platform up to date.
Process automation and maintenance of critical business systems, focused on replacing manual work with bots and automated integrations.
Built RPA bots in C# and .NET Worker Services to collect and process data automatically, eliminating recurring manual tasks.
Implemented web crawling and scraping solutions to integrate external systems, automating flows that were previously 100% manual.
Maintained and evolved a legacy Delphi/Object Pascal ERP in production, focusing on stability, critical fixes and business rule changes.
Supported critical business processes, contributing directly to the operational reliability of the company's systems.
